name: UnityGaussianSplatting
description: Toy Gaussian Splatting visualization in Unity

paragraphs: SIGGRAPH 2023 had a paper "3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering" by Kerbl, Kopanas, Leimkühler, Drettakis that is really cool! Check out their website, source code repository, data sets and so on. I've decided to try to implement the realtime visualization part (i.e. the one that takes already-produced gaussian splat "model" file) in Unity.
Everything in this repository is based on that "OG" gaussian splatting paper. Towards end of 2023, there's a ton of new gaussian splatting research coming out; none of that is in this project.
:warning: Status as of 2023 December: I'm not planning any significant further developments.
features: Some virtual reality devices work (reportedly HTC Vive, Varjo Aero, Quest 3 and Quest Pro). Some others might not
Anything using OpenGL or OpenGL ES: #26
WebGPU might work someday, but seems that today it does not quite have all the required graphics features yet: #65
Mobile may or might not work. Some iOS devices definitely do not work (#72),

whatItDoes.text: SIGGRAPH 2023 had a paper "3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering" by Kerbl, Kopanas, Leimkühler, Drettakis that is really cool! Check out their website, source code repository, data sets and so on. I've decided to try to implement the realtime visualization part (i.e. the one that takes already-produced gaussian splat "model" file) in Unity.

requirements.text: The rendering takes game object transformation matrix into account; the official gaussian splat models seem to be all rotated by about -160 degrees around X axis, and mirrored around Z axis, so in the sample scene the object has such a transform set up.
